text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 98-99 पर एक पिता का अपने बेटे के टीचर को पत्र पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 98-99 par ek pita ka apne bete ke teacher ko patra padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read a father's letter to his son's teacher on pages 98–99 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: Who is the writer of this letter?
Why did he write the letter?
options: to ask the teacher to teach his son good values for life
to complain about the school fees
steps.answer: to ask the teacher to teach his son good values for life
steps.modelAnswer: He wrote the letter to request the teacher to teach his son good values and lessons for life.

modelMeaning.hi: उन्होंने टीचर से अपने बेटे को ज़िंदगी के अच्छे मूल्य और सबक़ सिखाने का अनुरोध करने के लिए पत्र लिखा।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Unhone teacher se apne bete ko zindagi ke achhe moolya aur sabak sikhaane ka anurodh karne ke liye patra likha.

steps.question: Who did he write the letter to?
What did he ask the teacher to teach his son? (any one)

questionMeaning.hi: उन्होंने बेटे को क्या सिखाने को कहा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Unhone bete ko kya sikhaane ko kaha?

options: It is far more honourable to fail than to cheat.
steps.answer: It is far more honourable to fail than to cheat.

steps.question: In whom should one have sublime faith, and why?

questionMeaning.hi: किसमें गहरी आस्था रखनी चाहिए और क्यों?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kismein gehri aastha rakhni chahiye aur kyon?

options: in the creator and in oneself, so one has faith in mankind
steps.answer: in the creator and in oneself, so one has faith in mankind
steps.modelAnswer: One should have sublime faith in the creator and in oneself, because then one will always have faith in mankind.

modelMeaning.hi: हमें ईश्वर और ख़ुद पर गहरी आस्था रखनी चाहिए, क्योंकि तब हम इंसानियत पर भी भरोसा रखेंगे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Humein Ishwar aur khud par gehri aastha rakhni chahiye, kyonki tab hum insaaniyat par bhi bharosa rakhenge.

text.hi: (B) क्रिया (verb) से संज्ञा (noun) बनाओ: laugh → laughter।
text.hinglish: (B) Kriya (verb) se sangya (noun) banao: laugh → laughter.
text.en: (B) Make nouns from verbs: laugh → laughter.

instruction.hi: Verb को उसके noun से जोड़ो
instruction.hinglish: Verb ko uske noun se jodo
instruction.en: Join each verb to its noun
